en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a garden scene at a girls' gymnasium boarding school run by nuns. In the park, schoolgirls in dark uniforms and nuns in habits sit at outdoor tables reading or writing, while others stand or walk along a curved path bordered by flowerbeds and trees. The reverse side is laid out as a divided back postcard, printed in Hungarian, with space for address and message.
